name: binary_session
description: Report the active binary target or resource-only app root, provider and capability availability when applicable, client-feature, analysis, and server-identity status without starting analysis. analysis_provider_candidates_observed distinguishes this status request from retained target-selection observations; selection-time readiness may have changed. Set refresh_candidates true to inspect current candidates without changing the active binding or engine. open_binary with an explicit provider_id reselects and may retire the previous engine and its ephemeral edits; reopening the same target without provider_id reuses its current route. A selected provider may report release_verification under its binding; omission means not reported, and reported-version verification does not authenticate executable bytes. Start with the default summary: after selecting Ghidra, capabilities[].shared_limitations already reports enabled checkpoint or ephemeral mode. Request detail: "complete" only for provider diagnostics, candidate capabilities or static tool flags; omitted_fields lists what summary leaves out.

detail.description: Start with summary (default): it keeps open state, the binding, current-route capabilities (including selected Ghidra checkpoint mode), each provider candidate's availability and target-support status, code and reason, and every tool's availability, reason and remediation; omitted_fields lists what it leaves out. Request complete only when you need unavailable-candidate remediation, provider diagnostics, candidate capabilities or static tool surface, effect and annotation flags.
